tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_disruptor_thunder_s: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
Thunder Strike additionally hits all enemies within Kinetic Field. Thunder Strike Slow duration is increased to %slow_duration%s.
Disruptor's charged coils occasionally overload, and a singed armor plate or tuft of fur is the enemy's result.

Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to %shard_ground_delay% seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_disruptor_bio:
High on the wind-ravaged steppes of Druud, a gifted young stormcrafter called Disruptor was the first to unlock the secrets of the summer squalls. Constantly under assault from both seasonal storms and encroachment from civilized kingdoms to the South, the upland Oglodi have for centuries struggled to subsist atop the endless tablelands. They are the fractured remnant of a once-great civilization, a fallen tribe, their stormcraft strange and inscrutable, cobbled together from scraps of lost knowledge which even they no longer fully understand. For those on the high plain, weather has become a kind of religion, worshiped as both the giver and taker of life. But the electrical storms that bring life-sustaining rains arrive at a cost, and many are the charred and smoking corpses left in their wake.

Although small for his kind, Disruptor is fearless, and driven by an insatiable curiosity. As a youth, while still unblooded and without a stryder, he explored the ruins of the ancestral cities, searching through collapsed and long-moldering libraries, rummaging through rusting manufactories. He took what he needed and returned to his tribe. Adapting a coil of ancient design, he harnessed the power of electrical differential and now calls down the thunder whenever he wishes. Part magic, part craftsmanship, his coils hold in their glowing plates the power of life and death--a power wielded with precision against the landed castes to the South, and any interlopers who cross into ancient Oglodi lands.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_disruptor_hype: Disruptor excels at shattering the plans of his enemies. Summoning impassable fences to trap targets as he calls down a silencing storm, should a foe attempt something unexpected he simply teleports them back to their earlier location.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_disruptor_npedesc1: Traps and silences foes in his static storm

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}}
** Creates the Glimpse [[projectile]] from the affected unit's current position which travels towards the lapsed time mark, this indicates the location the affected enemy hero will land.
** {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
*** The location at which the affected enemy hero lands after Glimpse is marked with a blue visual effect visible to everyone.
*** Has the following {{M|projectile speed|text=travel speeds}}, whichever is faster:
***# {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Teleport}} at {{#var:Glimpse basic1}}-speed.
***# {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Teleport}} in {{#var:Glimpse value2}} seconds.

[[File:Glimpse ability.png|thumb|250px|Blue visual effects marking the location at which the target lands.]]

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{Symbol|Teleport}}
** Does not {{M|disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}}.
** Applies the following effects on the affected enemy hero:
*** {{M|Silence}}
*** Issues a stop command.
** Affects the following units:
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** Does not [[teleport]] units affected by the following sources:
** {{M|Debuff immune}} units.
** {{M|Hidden}} units.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** When the enemy unit has just respawned less than {{#var:Glimpse value1}} seconds ago:
*** For enemy heroes, teleports the affected enemy to the {{M|fountain}}.
*** For newly summoned {{M|creep-heroes}}, teleports them to the middle of the map.
*** Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|strong illusions}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes; other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
The stryder is immune to the gale-force winds that will consume its adversaries.

mechanics
fields.value:
* The {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted damage and its {{Symbol|Target|Area}} radius damage component is independent of each other.
** Hence, the following sources do not stop Thunder Strike from hitting other units:
*** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} sources.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** {{M|Exposes}} the affected enemy unit, but does not grant {{M|True Sight}} over it.
** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
*** Grants a 3.34-second 450-radius [[flying vision]] at the affected enemy unit's last location.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|disruptor_thunder_strike}}
*** Deals {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} in {{#expr:{{#var:Thunder Strike value7}}/({{#var:Thunder Strike value2}}-1)}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Thunder Strike value7 tal}}/({{#var:Thunder Strike value2 tal}}-1)}}|tal}})-second intervals, immediately upon debuff application.
*** The debuff persist {{M|death}}, and continues striking the death location if the target dies.
*** Reapplying the debuff refreshes the duration.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{M|Exposes}} the affected enemy unit.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|disruptor_thunder_strike_speed}}
*# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} instance.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_disruptor
data.bio_loc:
High on the wind-ravaged steppes of Druud, a gifted young stormcrafter called Disruptor was the first to unlock the secrets of the summer squalls. Constantly under assault from both seasonal storms and encroachment from civilized kingdoms to the South, the upland Oglodi have for centuries struggled to subsist atop the endless tablelands. They are the fractured remnant of a once-great civilization, a fallen tribe, their stormcraft strange and inscrutable, cobbled together from scraps of lost knowledge which even they no longer fully understand. For those on the high plain, weather has become a kind of religion, worshiped as both the giver and taker of life. But the electrical storms that bring life-sustaining rains arrive at a cost, and many are the charred and smoking corpses left in their wake.

Although small for his kind, Disruptor is fearless, and driven by an insatiable curiosity. As a youth, while still unblooded and without a stryder, he explored the ruins of the ancestral cities, searching through collapsed and long-moldering libraries, rummaging through rusting manufactories. He took what he needed and returned to his tribe. Adapting a coil of ancient design, he harnessed the power of electrical differential and now calls down the thunder whenever he wishes. Part magic, part craftsmanship, his coils hold in their glowing plates the power of life and death--a power wielded with precision against the landed castes to the South, and any interlopers who cross into ancient Oglodi lands.
data.hype_loc: Disruptor excels at shattering the plans of his enemies. Summoning impassable fences to trap targets as he calls down a silencing storm, should a foe attempt something unexpected he simply teleports them back to their earlier location.
data.npe_desc_loc: Traps and silences foes in his static storm

abilities.name: disruptor_thunder_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
abilities.lore_loc: Disruptor's charged coils occasionally overload, and a singed armor plate or tuft of fur is the enemy's result.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to %shard_ground_delay% seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.
facets_loc: Thunder Strike additionally hits all enemies within Kinetic Field. Thunder Strike Slow duration is increased to %slow_duration%s.

abilities.name: disruptor_glimpse
abilities.desc_loc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
abilities.lore_loc: Playing with electricity can have unexpected results.
notes_loc: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

abilities.name: disruptor_kinetic_field
abilities.desc_loc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
abilities.lore_loc: The stryder is immune to the gale-force winds that will consume its adversaries.
notes_loc: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.
abilities.shard_loc: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

abilities.name: disruptor_kinetic_fence
abilities.desc_loc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.
abilities.lore_loc: For a brief moment, it's as if the wind itself had turned solid.

abilities.name: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
abilities.lore_loc: Safe harbor found inside the storm.
notes_loc: After %damage_reset_interval%s, the damage counter is reset.

abilities.name: disruptor_static_storm
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
abilities.lore_loc: A summer squall in Druud is a hardship that only an Oglodi can survive.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_disruptor_consecutive_strike_damage
talents.desc_loc: Every strike increases the damage of subsequent strikes until the debuff expires
